name: maestro
description: Maestro multi-agent orchestrator: install, update and run a project's workflow graph, hold a team meeting of its subagents (maestro-team-meeting), plus the skills the Maestro desktop app hands off to (create-skill, create-plugin, create-subagent, create-marketplace, manage-marketplace, update-skill-tags) and the scribe's concept-skill flows (create-concept-skills, update-concept-skills, update-single-concept-skill, cleanup-skill).
